question: What qualities belong to the one who knows this supreme form?
premises: The knower is a meritorious soul.
The knower is all-knowing and liberated.
The knower is identified as Shiva himself.
inference: True knowledge of the supreme form confers the highest spiritual identity and qualities.
plain_english: O beloved, he is a meritorious soul, he is all-knowing, he is liberated, he is Shiva himself.
